report_name: Critical GnuPG Library Flaw Could Lead to Data Exfiltration

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-129975
vulnerabilities.description: A critical double-free memory corruption vulnerability in the GnuPG Made Easy (GPGME) library affecting all versions before 2.3.0. The flaw can be triggered when an application processes a malicious OpenPGP key containing a specially crafted, long user ID, potentially leading to data exfiltration or remote code execution.
